status: static-confirmed; observer contract only; no CK3 launch, attach, or live snapshot in this work package
scope: nonreligious major decision P0 slice: found_kingdom_decision

religion_scope.piety_boundary: piety is retained only as the authored generic resource cost; no faith or religion semantics are inferred

line_anchors.text: ai_goal = yes/no 				# If set, the AI will consider the decision a "goal" and consider it alongside major costs like title creation and holding construction. It will ignore ai_check_interval. Should only be used for things with such major costs that budgeting for it is important, as it is less performant than using a high ai_check_interval

ai_check_interval = 42			# How many months to go between each check of this decision. Has to be set (or 'ai_check_interval_by_tier') , except if ai_goal = yes is set. An interval of 0 means the AI will never check this decision.

ai_check_interval_by_tier = {	# How often should the ai check this decision by tier of top title (in months). '0' means it is never considered. Used instead of 'ai_check_interval'. All tiers are required to be defined.
is_shown = { ... }				# is decision available to the character; scope: character; default: { always = yes }
is_valid_showing_failures_only = { ... }	# can execute decision; these will be shown in the confirm button tooltip if they fail; scope: character; default: { always = yes }
is_valid = { ... }				# can execute decision; these will be shown in the detail view under Requirements; scope: character; default: { always = yes }
effect = { ... }				# effect to execute when decision is taken; scope: character
ai_potential = { ... }			# trigger whether the AI should look at it or not

ai_will_do = { ... }			# Returns the % chance of executing executing the decision. 0 will never execute it, 100 will alwasy execute it. Will also determine the default option (if the decision has those) for players .

candidate.source_semantics: interval 0 is never considered; duchy tier is considered every 60 months

ordered_authored_operations: save founder and old primary title scopes
create title-and-vassal change, assign the new title to root, then resolve the change
choose a represented de-jure empire when one is found and set it as the new kingdom's de-jure liege
move every held duchy and every fully controlled unheld duchy found by the authored scan under the new kingdom
copy coat of arms, color, and capital from the old primary title
set the new kingdom as primary title
trigger major_decisions.1101 for the founder and .1102/.1105 notification paths for affected players
human_only_tail: on the first human execution, set global_var:found_kingdom_decision to root
on the first human execution, set global_var:found_kingdom_decision_kingdom to root.primary_title
